sentences.ar: قال جو الهندي: الشغلة الأخيرة، وبعدها بنروح على تكساس.
sentences.en: Injun Joe said: the last job, and after it we go to Texas.
The old man said: the job is dangerous.
The whole village knows your face.

sentences.ar: قال جو الهندي: ما بعرفوني هيك.
sentences.en: Injun Joe said: they do not know me like this.

sentences.ar: وأنا ما برجع لتكساس قبل ما آخد حقي.
sentences.en: And I do not go to Texas before I take my due.

sentences.ar: وحكوا عن مصاري مخبيينها، ستمية دولار، وبدهم يدفنوها بالبيت.
sentences.en: And they talked of money they had hidden, six hundred dollars, and wanting to bury it in the house.

sentences.ar: وجو الهندي قام يحفر بالزاوية، بسكينته.
sentences.en: And Injun Joe got up to dig in the corner, with his knife.

sentences.ar: وفوق، توم وهَك، بيسمعوا، وبيحلموا بالستمية.
sentences.en: And above, Tom and Huck, listening, dreaming of the six hundred.
And then the knife struck something.
Joe said: wood.
And they dug with the pick, and brought up a box.
An old iron box, heavy, and locked.
And they broke the lock, and opened it.
Gold.

sentences.ar: صندوق كامل من العملات الذهبية، آلاف، بتلمع بالغبار.
sentences.en: A whole box of gold coins, thousands, shining in the dust.

sentences.ar: قال العجوز: هاي كنز عصابة موريل!
sentences.en: The old man said: this is the Murrell gang's treasure!
They were here years ago!

sentences.ar: وقال جو الهندي: هلق مش لازم نعمل الشغلة الأخيرة.
sentences.en: And Injun Joe said: now we do not need to do the last job.
And then he said: no.
I do it.
The job is not for money.
The job is revenge.
And in that moment, Injun Joe saw the pick.
A new pick, with fresh earth on it.
He said: who brought this pick?
And he looked at the stairs.

sentences.ar: وتوم وهَك، فوق، سمعوا الخشب بيصر، وهو طالع.
sentences.en: And Tom and Huck, above, heard the wood creak, as he climbed.
One step.
Two.
Three.

sentences.ar: وفكروا يقفزوا من الشباك، بس ما قدروا يتحركوا.
sentences.en: And they thought of jumping from the window, but could not move.
And on the fourth step, the rotten wood broke.

sentences.ar: ووقع جو الهندي لتحت، على العجوز.
sentences.en: And Injun Joe fell down, onto the old man.
And he got up cursing, and said: enough.

sentences.ar: لو في حدا فوق، خليه يضل فوق.
sentences.en: If there is anyone up there, let him stay up there.
And whoever wants to come down, comes down.

sentences.ar: وأخدوا الصندوق، وقال جو: ما بنخبيه هون.
sentences.en: And they took the box, and Joe said: we do not hide it here.

sentences.ar: بنوديه على رقم اتنين، تحت الصليب.
sentences.en: We take it to Number Two, under the cross.
And they went out at sunset, with the gold.

sentences.ar: وتوم وهَك نزلوا بعد ساعة، وإجريهم بترجف.
sentences.en: And Tom and Huck came down an hour later, their legs shaking.
And Tom said: Number Two.
Under the cross.
We must find it.
